summary: N-MOSFET AO3400A low side, 3.30 V gate, 2.00 A: R_DS(on) 48.0 mΩ (at V_GS 2.50 V, datasheet) gives 192 mW loss and 96.0 mV drop, T_J ≈ 49.0 °C (within T_J max 150 °C).

r_th_ja.conditions: maximum, steady state, on 1 in² FR-4 with 2 oz copper in still air (Notes A, D)

result.formula: V_GS = V_gate · R_PD / (R_G + R_PD); R_DS(on) = datasheet maximum at the highest V_GS row ≤ V_GS; P = I_load² · R_DS(on); V_DS = I_load · R_DS(on); T_J = T_A + P · R_θJA; I_G,peak = V_gate / R_G

checks.detail: R_DS(on) max 48.0 mΩ specified at V_GS 2.50 V ≤ 3.30 V (AO3400A datasheet)
V_supply 12.0 V ≤ V_DS max 30.0 V (AO3400A datasheet)
I_load 2.00 A ≤ I_D 5.70 A (AO3400A datasheet, continuous, T_A = 25 °C, V_GS = 10 V); the T_J check is the limit at your gate voltage
R_G 100 Ω and R_PD 100 kΩ in the usual ranges (rule of thumb)

warnings.message: The gate draws up to 33.0 mA (V_gate / R_G) from the pin for a moment at each switching edge. GPIO current limits are not checked here (unverified); see the chip datasheet.

assumptions.reason: chip not given; ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 values: GPIO high at 3.3 V; the ESP32-S3 guarantees V_OH ≥ 0.8 × VDD = 2.64 V (WROOM-1 datasheet Table 6-3, no load): gate_v 2.64 is the worst case
steady state, R_G and R_PD divide the pin voltage; selects the datasheet row

assumptions.value: 48.0 mΩ max at V_GS 2.50 V, I_D 3.00 A
assumptions.reason: AO3400A datasheet, T_J = 25 °C, pulsed: highest row ≤ V_GS 3.30 V (R_DS(on) falls with V_GS, so an upper bound at 25 °C); it rises with T_J (datasheet curve), not included in P
AO3400A datasheet, maximum, steady state, on 1 in² FR-4 with 2 oz copper in still air (Notes A, D); your board decides
rule of thumb: R_G limits the pin current into the gate and damps ringing; R_PD keeps the MOSFET off while the pin floats (boot, reset, flashing)
PWM adds switching losses (not included); coils and motors need a flyback diode (rule of thumb); low voltage only, never mains
room temperature; inside a case it is warmer
